name: Production Deployment Gate Closure

checks.label: Public HTTPS URL
checks.evidence: VIDGRAVITY_PUBLIC_BASE_URL is absent or not HTTPS
checks.required_action: Deploy behind a valid TLS reverse proxy and set VIDGRAVITY_PUBLIC_BASE_URL

checks.label: Docker CLI
checks.evidence: Docker CLI not detected in this environment
checks.required_action: Build and start the image on a Docker-capable host; record image and runtime results

checks.label: Provider engine
checks.required_action: Install the pinned provider dependency and run the authorized live-provider test

checks.label: Authorized live-provider URL
checks.required_action: Use an authorized, non-DRM test URL and run provider_live_acceptance.py

checks.label: Payment secret configuration
checks.evidence: One or more required Razorpay variables are missing; values are never displayed
checks.required_action: Configure secrets in the deployment secret manager and test order, signature, webhook, and idempotency

checks.label: Native Android wrapper
checks.evidence: No Gradle wrapper found in expected project locations
checks.required_action: Generate native wrapper, build APK, then test emulator and physical device

checks.label: Provider egress isolation
checks.required_action: Enforce and independently test OS/container network policy blocking private, loopback, link-local and metadata endpoints

important_note: READY means a local prerequisite/configuration signal only. It does not prove a successful deployment, payment, download, Android installation, or security review.
remaining_manual_gates: Public HTTPS health check from outside deployment network
Authorized provider download and output inspection
Native APK install and acceptance on emulator and physical device
Independent verification of provider-process egress restrictions
Independent security review before public launch
